occurrences.text: Behold, I stand by the well of water; and it shall come to pass, that when the virgin cometh forth to draw water, and I say to her, Give me, I pray thee, a little water of thy pitcher to drink;

occurrences.text: And Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, Go. And the maid went and called the child’s mother.
The singers went before, the players on instruments followed after; among them were the damsels playing with timbrels.
Because of the savour of thy good ointments thy name is as ointment poured forth, therefore do the virgins love thee.
There are threescore queens, and fourscore concubines, and virgins without number.
Therefore the Lord himself shall give you a sign; Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.
